offering_description.value: Operates the largest cinema advertising network in the US, selling on-screen pre-show ads and lobby and digital placements to national, regional and local advertisers. Delivers ads through theater partners' screens and lobby displays.

primary_products.value: cinema pre-show advertising inventory; lobby digital network advertising placements; digital advertising inventory

primary_services.value: cinema advertising sales; campaign management; audience measurement and targeting

customer_segment.value: B2B: national, regional and local advertisers and ad agencies

end_markets.value: advertising; movie theaters; consumer goods; automotive; entertainment

revenue_model.value: advertising: advertisers pay for on-screen and lobby ad placements in theaters

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys access to theater screens from exhibitors and sells ad inventory to advertisers and agencies

geography_served.value: US national: Theaters and advertisers across the United States

specialization.value: niche specialist: cinema and theater-based advertising

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales force selling to advertisers and agencies; partners / resellers: theater circuit partners hosting network screens and displays
